hooks.name: Song Validate (new file)
hooks.description: Deterministic Suno format check when a song file is created under songs/: Style/Lyrics character limits, required elements ([Title:], direction blocks, [End]), Exclude-field format, V6 tag grammar, artist and gear names. README.md and *.brief.md are skipped by the script.

hooks.name: Song Validate (save)
hooks.description: Re-runs the deterministic Suno format check every time an agent saves a song file under songs/. Report any FAIL to the user with the fix.
